title: Issue 1 pages 1-2: next budget
summary: Your 'finish Issue 1 pages 1-2'. 12 runs, no timeouts. Five panels passed Claude's review after one fix each (p1-1, p1-2, p1-3, p2-3, p2-5). Three wait on you: p2-1 and p2-2 came back the wrong shape (tall instead of nearly square), and p2-4 has the wrong shape, a two-tailed Skarn and a filled stamp. Today is at 25, so those fixes were not run.
